description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Leila)] and [Water Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Leila)

description.name: Dual Aqua Gaze
